# Least Squares Moving Average

*Least squares line through the last N closes, at its end.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Least Squares Moving Average** under **Moving averages**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `25` |
| Offset | int | `0` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/lsma.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Least Squares Moving Average", shortTitle: "LSMA", overlay: true });
const length = input.int("Length", 25, { min: 1 });
const offset = input.int("Offset", 0, { min: -500, max: 500 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
plot(ta.linreg(src, length, offset), { title: "LSMA", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
